reviewed_source.function_comparison: Complete top-level function text, no AST/import/compilation.

findings: The seven-input accepted-model loader binds the new producer, independent native checker, corrected CI, exact configuration, preparation/cold reports and owners, and planned root acceptance interface. It checks the unchanged combined-parent restoration and all three appended row families.

The loader uses actual fields emitted by native checker 1bf43879. It does not require a runtime dictionary, preparation_source, authorities, producer_imports, native_imports, or protobuf_decoder_only from that native cold. Runtime/model descriptor identity comes from the query configuration, native preparation and the decoder's own descriptor.
The original edge slice is exactly [540,68934), even though all 80730 variables remain. All 68394 edge names, Boolean domains and complete order hash are checked.

The repeated subsolver parameter uses .extend in exact declared order no_lp, quick_restart_no_lp, portfolio_no_lp. Four workers and three full subsolvers are explicit. Complete parameter text/wire messages and pinned runtime hashes are compared.

Integer validation is unchanged from the accepted parent: every value must have exact Python int type, every variable interval is checked, and every complete linear row activity is computed by indexed Python-integer multiplication and addition. All saved activity bytes and all primary/additional vectors are compared.

Response text and reconstructed wire must encode the same complete response. Native vector snapshots, status, all candidate file names and values, selection and original-edge extraction are checked against it.

The checker independently rederives UNKNOWN, native-overrun, unproved-INFEASIBLE, model-invalid, missing-vector and rejected-vector statuses. No status or model vector is promoted to a full graph or component exclusion.

The query, preflight and independent owners must bind the declared inputs and have accepted, reaped, stopped process groups within their budgets. Final checker serialization is included in its own 10/120-second worker checks, with inherited 15/135-second external owners.

Unlike the native-model checker, this query checker intentionally emits producer_imports and native_imports as zero in both controls and main; the fresh query CI's inherited checks therefore match its actual output. All controls/main CLI arguments and PASS/status fields match the frozen runner and fresh CI.
